objective: Turn the independently preferred M359 q32/O4 exact PWP point into a timestamped finite-resource module cycle trace with one DMA server, two 32 KiB slots, explicit pattern/tile/descriptor addresses, all-row matcher-to-descriptor writes, one-row-per-cycle descriptor replay and finite backpressure, while reproducing the stronger frozen bit-sparse baseline.

finite_execution_model.descriptor_write_fusion: Every SERIAL16 row result already contains original pattern, winning ID, residual and use_pwp; write the 48-bit descriptor directly at row retirement. No assignment-only post-packer is allowed.
finite_execution_model.descriptor_bundle_queue: A descriptor SRAM reader produces at most one complete residual-mask/PWP bundle per cycle into an eight-entry FIFO. The compute server consumes bundles in row order; zero-work bundles consume one dispatch cycle, while any nonzero bundle takes at least four SHARED96 cycles at O4. Producer II=1 is therefore never slower than consumer service, and finite backpressure cannot create a post-start underflow.
finite_execution_model.candidate_tile_service_cycles: sum exact SHARED96 O4 work plus count of zero-work rows
finite_execution_model.baseline: Reproduce frozen M358 q32 SHARED96 bit-sparse cycles using its stronger two-context next-phase scan/DMA overlap; do not weaken the baseline to phase-serial.
finite_execution_model.pwp_gather: Charge exact used-PWP payload and weights through the sole 32-byte/cycle DMA; all q32/O4 payload fragments are 32-byte aligned.

decision_rule.advance_to_vcs_scheduler_rtl: Only if the timestamped candidate is at least 1.05x faster than the reproduced frozen bit-sparse baseline, all address/capacity/DMA/queue invariants pass, and an independent hammer finds no P0/P1.
decision_rule.close: If speedup is below 1.05x or any finite-resource invariant fails, close q32 exact PWP as a performance contribution.

red_lines: Do not call exact vector-work reduction a cycle speedup.
Do not compare against a phase-serial weakened bit-sparse baseline.
Do not reuse WIDE144 or SYSTOLIC_Q resource-expansion endpoints.
